title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta12

## Aggregate Gate required

This beta adds one mower-level **Gate required** binary sensor for the common
Home Assistant automation case where several configured zone-pair Gate rules
all control the same physical gate.

Previously every configured Gate pair exposed only its own binary sensor. With
a map such as:

- Street2 <-> Front yard
- Street2 <-> Back yard

a user had to make the physical gate automation understand both entities.

0.5.0-beta12 keeps the individual path sensors for diagnostics and advanced
installations, but also exposes one stable mower-level Gate required entity.

### Conservative three-state OR

The aggregate state is intentionally fail-safe:

- if **any** configured Gate required state is true -> aggregate is **true**;
- if every configured Gate required state is false -> aggregate is **false**;
- if none is true and at least one Gate state is unknown -> aggregate is
  **unknown/unavailable**.

In other words, **true + unknown = true**, while false + unknown does not
incorrectly tell a physical-gate automation that it is safe to close.

Attributes expose:

- configured Gate count;
- active Gate slugs;
- unknown Gate slugs;
- each configured Gate name, zone pair and current required state.

### Existing automation compatibility

The historical default first Gate is normally slugged `gate` and commonly
already owns an entity ID such as:

`binary_sensor.<mower>_gate_required`

When that legacy default-Gate registry entry exists and the new aggregate stable
unique ID does not yet exist, beta12 migrates only its **unique ID** to the new
aggregate entity.

The Home Assistant **entity ID is left unchanged**, so an existing physical-gate
automation can continue listening to the same entity while its meaning expands
from one zone pair to all configured Gate paths.

The original default Gate pair is then created again as an individual path
sensor, and all individual sensors use names such as:

- Gate path required
- Gate2 path required

Named/non-default Gate registry entries are not automatically repurposed.

### Multiple physical gates

The aggregate sensor is intended as the convenient default for the usual
one-physical-gate installation. Users who really have multiple independent
physical gates can continue to automate the individual Gate path sensors
directly.

This beta does not change the underlying zone-pair Gate navigation algorithm.
A future side-A / side-B multi-zone Gate model can still replace duplicate
zone-pair configuration without changing the usefulness of the mower-level
aggregate entity.

No Map Card update is required. **Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta7** remains the
matching frontend.
